title: X (Twitter) Tweet Scraper
description: Provide at least one target: fromUsers or tweetIds. Filters combine with AND semantics; an unset filter means no constraint.

fromUsers.title: From users
fromUsers.description: Handles without @. Returns their recent tweets.

searchTerms.title: Search terms (NOT SUPPORTED IN THIS BUILD)
searchTerms.description: X's SearchTimeline operation is auth-walled to guest tokens. This build rejects search input at validation instead of silently returning nothing. See the README section 'Search'.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Without #. Applied as a post-filter on the fetched timelines. All listed hashtags must be present (AND).

since.title: Since
since.description: Inclusive lower bound on tweet creation time (ISO date).

until.title: Until
until.description: Inclusive upper bound on tweet creation time (ISO date).

onlyVerified.title: Only verified authors
onlyVerified.description: Verified by any current X program (Blue, legacy or identity verification).

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Author timelines are chronological. 'top' is accepted but only meaningful on ranked surfaces, which this build does not implement.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Requested cap. Free-tier accounts receive at most 10 items per run regardless of this value.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential rotation is recommended; datacenter IPs are blocked by X more aggressively.
